name: Avalanche Doors Trap (CR 5)
body:
Type mechanical Perception DC 14; Disable Device DC —

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset none

Effect Atk +15 melee (6d6 stone blocks and boulders); multiple targets (all targets in a 10-foot-square area).

If the doors are opened, a small avalanche of rock and stone pours into the room.
